description:
A plan for shopping with integrity on Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, Cyber Monday,
    Giving Tuesday or for holiday gifts: the date, days left, and which Shoptegrity tools to use at each step.
    occasion is black_friday, small_business_saturday, cyber_monday, giving_tuesday, christmas, or 'next'
    for the next one coming up. today is an ISO date and defaults to the server's date. For Black Friday,
    Cyber Monday and holiday gifts it also returns links to large retailers' own weekly-ad and deals pages.
name: holiday_shopping_guide
title: Holiday shopping guide
